meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞曲：Andre Hermanto
中譯詞：高安妮

lines.a: 我的名字 刻劃在祢心中
lines.b: You carved my name, deep inside Your heart

lines.a: 我的臉孔 深映在祢眼中
lines.b: Within Your sight, my face is painted on

lines.a: 不是因為 我勢力才能
lines.b: It's not because, my power or talent

lines.a: 乃是因著 祢奇妙寬容恩典
lines.b: But it's because, Your miraculous grace

lines.a: 雖然有時 我會跌倒軟弱
lines.b: Although at times, I will crumble and fall

lines.a: 祢卻一直 包容不放棄我
lines.b: But till the end, You refused to give me up

lines.a: 用祢慈愛 緊緊的擁抱
lines.b: You hug me tight, with Your gracious love

lines.a: 我讚美祢 寶貴奇妙大愛
lines.b: I praise You Lord, for Your priceless wondrous love

lines.a: 唯有祢配得 所有的讚美
lines.b: Only You're worthy, of all of our praise

lines.a: 主祢的十架 是無價至寶
lines.b: The cross that Lord You, bear for us is priceless
You are my almighty Lord Jesus
